subject: Activate inference capacity slot — open replacement requisition
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Activate inference capacity slot — request to open replacement req

Team —

We need to open a replacement requisition for the Senior Inference Engineer on my team. Individual is going on a medical leave (expected 4–6 months) and we need coverage ASAP to keep the infra rollout (KV cache work + quantization validation) on schedule. High-level asks:
- Headcount: temporary backfill that can convert to perm if we get approval later
- Target start: earliest availability in Feb; first onsite interview week of Feb 7
- Comp band: same range as previous hire for senior inference roles
- Interview panel: 4 loops (technical infra, systems design, runtime performance, manager) — I attached a JD and a proposed panel template.

Please confirm: 1) greenlight to open the req, 2) panel volunteers, 3) any mandatory on-call expectations to call out in the posting.

Attached: senior-inference-jd.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activate inference capacity slot — request to open replacement req

On Mon, Jan 11, 2027 at 9:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> We need to open a replacement requisition for the Senior Inference Engineer on my team...

Thanks for the details, Vanessa — I can take point on req creation. A few clarifying Qs before I open:
- Level: Senior (IC4) or Senior+ (IC5) — will this require sign-off from Eng L5 comp?
- On-call: include a single page duty (1:6 rotation) or mark as optional for now?
- Remote/hybrid: will we limit to US-only or open to remote (US/Canada)?

Proposed panel (tentative volunteers):
- Technical infra: Markus Klein (recruiter lead will coordinate tech screen)
- Systems design: Aditya Rao
- Runtime perf: Vanessa Ortiz
- Manager loop: Marissa Cole (if available)

Timeline: open GH req this week -> screen 10–12 candidates -> first-round interviews week of Feb 7. I attached a panel-template.csv with suggested timeboxes.

If you want, I can draft the posting language and target candidate sources (top-tier infra job boards, vendor pipeline via talentops@vendorrecruit.com).

-Markus
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T12:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activate inference capacity slot — request to open replacement req

Vanessa —

Greenlight to open the requisition. Operational priority checks out; keep compensation within the existing senior band (no escalation unless candidate is exceptional and requires IC5). Please include the on-call expectation explicitly (1:6) but mark the role as eligible for remote within US only.

Two asks:
1) If this becomes urgent and we can’t fill in 6 weeks, get me a costed contractor option to bridge.
2) Make sure the JD calls out quantization and KV cache experience — that’s non-negotiable.

I’ll try to join the manager loop for the final interview but if I’m out you have my explicit sign-off to move forward.

Marissa Cole
VP, Infrastructure & Serving
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activate inference capacity slot — request to open replacement req

Budget check — finance has headroom in Q1 for one backfill on the Infrastructure org. Code PO-2027-01-INF has been reserved; I attached the short PO stub. Approve to proceed with GH-req creation.

Notes: keep projected OTE within previously approved senior band to avoid additional comp approvals. If you want to convert to perm later, we’ll run the conversion approval separately.

Attachment: budget-approval-PO.txt

-Aditya Rao
Head of Finance Partnerships (partnering with Eng)
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T16:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activate inference capacity slot — request to open replacement req

Thanks all —

Markus / Tessa: please proceed. Markus, open Greenhouse requisition GH-4721 (use PO-2027-01-INF). Draft posting with the JD attached; call out 1:6 on-call and US-only remote. Tessa, coordinate panel invites and confirm Aditya & Marissa availability for the final manager loop (Marissa will try to attend).

Proposed first-round slots (all PST):
- Wed Feb 9: 9:00–12:00 (4 candidates)
- Thu Feb 10: 13:00–17:00 (4 candidates)

Also looping in external vendor (talentops@vendorrecruit.com) to push any prior pipeline candidates. Sarah from Acme-ML is an external contractor we can fast-track if needed (sarah@acme-ml.com).

I’ll kick off a short calibration doc in the GH req (link above). Please confirm when GH-4721 is live and share the interview scheduling doc.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
